capabilities: auto-fit canvases on open with width-first framing
pin the top of the canvas while lower rows stay off-screen
limit auto-fit by a configurable folder path prefix
re-apply framing via a Fit canvas to width command
open external URLs from text cards with one click
extras: README is largely written for submitting the plugin to the community directory rather than for end users.
intentEvidence: Overrides canvas zoomToFit while the plugin is active
problem: Obsidian's default canvas zoom-to-fit shrinks tall boards to show everything, making cards in wide project boards too small to read.
summary: Canvas utility that zooms a canvas on open so its width fills the viewport with the top pinned, instead of fitting all content.
